title: A product of geometrically irreducible schemes is geometrically irreducible
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] which are geometrically irreducible over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Then the fibre product $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product], a scheme over $k$ through either projection followed by the structure morphism, is geometrically irreducible over $k$: for every field extension $k'/k$ [def-pc-field-extension] the base change $(X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}Y)\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ [def-pc-base-change] is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components].
